output.rationale: The requirement specifies NEMA LA 1 Surge Arresters within the context of Metal Clad Switchgear for Syracuse Airport. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product that provides arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the specification's focus on switchgear and related standards. This product is the most relevant match for the requirement.
